verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the Entity Management API page has an OpenAPI Specification File section with a downloadable spec, which delivers the core of the story. The probe's 404s on guessed well-known paths (openapi.json, swagger.json) only show the spec isn't at a conventional discoverable URL. They do not contradict the documented download. Missing for 10: evidence of downloadable specs for the other SAM.gov APIs (Opportunities, Exclusions, Contracts, Federal Hierarchy), a conventional or discoverable spec URL, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec file downloads and is valid.
